title: Vietnam increases solar tariffs for 2026, maintains storage premiums
summary: Vietnam has set 2026 electricity generation price ceilings for ground-mounted solar projects ranging from VND 1,104.32 ($0.04)/kWh in the south to VND 1,591.02/kWh in the north. For floating solar, the maximum prices range from VND 1,340.21/kWh in the south to VND 1,939.74/kWh in the north. The post Vietnam increases solar tariffs for 2026, maintains storage premiums appeared first on pv magazine Global .
